stock.description: Wuhan Youji Holdings Ltd. functions as an investment holding enterprise primarily involved in the creation and global distribution of chemical products derived from toluene. The company's diverse offerings include toluene oxidation products, toluene chlorination products, and benzoic acid ammonification products, alongside specialty fine chemicals such as benzyl acetate and p-methyl chlorobenzyl. Beyond manufacturing, it also trades in raw toluene. These chemical solutions are vital ingredients in various sectors, such as food preservation and oxidation, household goods, animal feed acidification, and as intermediates for agricultural and pharmaceutical industries. Established in 1946 and headquartered in Wuhan, People's Republic of China, Wuhan Youji Holdings Ltd. serves a broad international market spanning Mainland China, the rest of Asia, the Americas, and Europe. The company operates as a controlled entity under Vastocean Capital Limited.
